notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[h3]🔧 [b]Patch Notes – Demo Update[/b][/h3][p]Here are the latest improvements and fixes based on recent feedback:[/p][list][*][p]🛠️ [b]Chest Interaction Fix[/b]
Resolved an issue where the combination lock on the chest could be reopened after unlocking, causing the player camera to break. This behavior has been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]🔐 [b]Lantern Key Fix[/b]
Players can no longer retrieve a key from the lanterns located outside the front door, as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]👻 [b]Kitchen Jump Scare Trigger[/b]
The jump scare near the kitchen will now only trigger if the player is actively looking in the correct direction, improving timing and immersion.[/p][/*][*][p]⚡ [b]Stamina Adjustment[/b]
Increased the stamina recharge rate to allow for smoother movement and better pacing during gameplay.[/p][previewyoutube="yyZ01oMFYnw;full"][/previewyoutube][/*][/list]
